project_type: Vite + React 18 + TypeScript SPA (frontend) + new Node.js/Express/SQLite backend (server/)
build_system: Vite 5 for frontend (vite.config.ts). Server has no build step — runs with node server/index.js. Root package.json is 'type': 'module'; server/package.json must be 'type': 'commonjs'. Tailwind via PostCSS.
test_framework: None currently. No test runner is configured.
build_command: npm run build (runs vite build for frontend only)
test_command: No automated tests. Manual verification: node server/index.js in server/ dir, then curl http://localhost:3001/api/dashboard/stats
verification_instructions: 1. cd server && node index.js — server must start, print 'PrismGuard server running on :3001', and log 'Database initialised'. 2. curl http://localhost:3001/api/dashboard/stats — must return JSON with totalPrompts/allowed/blocked/connectedResources. 3. From project root: npm run dev — Vite must start on :5173 with no TS errors. 4. Browser: Dashboard must show non-zero numbers from DB, not hardcoded KPIs. 5. Chat: POST /api/prompts must store prompt and return pipeline result. 6. Admin Review: GET /api/admin/reviews must return seed review items.
snapshot_or_generated_files: server/database/prismguard.db is auto-generated at first startup; it is in .gitignore and must NOT be committed. schema.sql and seed.sql are committed.
environment_constraints: Windows 10/11 dev machine. PowerShell is the shell. Node.js version: check with node --version before installing better-sqlite3 (native addon — must match Node ABI). better-sqlite3 is synchronous; all DB calls in server are sync. .env is at project root; server loads it with require('dotenv').config({ path: require('path').join(__dirname, '../.env') }). PORT in .env is currently 8000 — server must default to 3001 if PORT env var not provided, or use a separate SERVER_PORT. Vite proxy target must be http://localhost:3001.
contribution_requirements: Git commit email must be kanishjebamathew.m@gmail.com. Commit message must summarise all changes. No push — local commit only unless workflow's finalize step handles it.
key_patterns: All frontend screens use named exports (export function Dashboard, export function ResourceDetail). Screens import directly from '@/data' using the '@' alias (mapped to src/ in vite.config.ts). Types are in src/types.ts — do NOT change type names or the existing interface shapes; only add new API-response types. Screens use useState+useEffect for loading; the loading skeleton pattern is already in every screen (setLoading after setTimeout). The api.ts wrappers must replace the setTimeout fake-load with real fetch calls. Server routes must use express.Router and be mounted at /api. CORS must allow http://localhost:5173.
directory_structure: project root: package.json (type:module), vite.config.ts, .env, index.html, src/ (App.tsx, types.ts, data.ts, screens/, components/), .agents/tasks/ (this dir).
